name: Sentry
description: Investigate errors, releases, and production issues.

methods.whenToUse: Use the provider-hosted connection for the quickest setup.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect the Sentry organization and projects agents need for incident work.

methods.whenToUse: Use a user auth token when an unattended agent needs Sentry access that does not expire with a browser sign-in grant.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect with a Sentry user auth token for unattended agents. Browser sign-in grants expire and need the owner to sign in again; a user auth token lasts until you revoke it.
methods.label: Use a user auth token

credentialFields.label: Sentry user auth token
credentialFields.helperMd: Create a user auth token with org:read, project:read, project:write, team:read, team:write and event:write. The token acts as its creator; Paperclip cannot increase an existing token's permissions.
